sd = df['Sleep Duration']

    # ASSERTION_START
    sys_ok = df['systolic'].between(90, 200).all()
    dia_ok = df['diastolic'].between(50, 120).all()
    order_ok = (df['systolic'] > df['diastolic']).all()
    assert sys_ok and dia_ok and order_ok
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Validate BMI Category before BMI-driven risk logic
    # ASSERTION_START
allowed_bmi = {'Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese'}
bmi_non_null = df['BMI Category'].notna().all()
bmi_allowed_ok = df['BMI Category'].isin(allowed_bmi).all()
assert bmi_non_null and bmi_allowed_ok
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Steps and Physical Activity Level relationship prior to activity scoring
    # Sleep Duration and Quality joint relationship prior to consistency scoring
    # BMI-BP coupling constraints prior to apnea inference
    # Sleep Disorder labeling prevalence used to calibrate referral rate
    # ASSERTION_START
sd_series = df['Sleep Disorder'].astype('object')
m_null = sd_series.isna()
m_ins = sd_series.eq('Insomnia')
m_apn = sd_series.eq('Sleep Apnea')
label_domain_ok = (m_null | m_ins | m_apn).all()
assert label_domain_ok
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Sleep scoring
    sleep_hours = df['Sleep Duration']
    qos_map = {i: i / 10.0 for i in range(1, 11)}
    qos_weight = df['Quality of Sleep'].map(qos_map)
    sleep_amount_score = 1.0 - (np.abs(sleep_hours - 8.0) / 5.0)
    sleep_amount_score = np.clip(sleep_amount_score, 0.0, 1.0)
    long_mask = sleep_hours >= 8.0
    short_mask = sleep_hours <= 4.5
    long_consistency = np.where(long_mask, (df['Quality of Sleep'] >= 7).astype(int), 1)
    short_consistency = np.where(short_mask, (df['Quality of Sleep'] <= 6).astype(int), 1)
    sleep_rule_bonus = 0.05 * (long_consistency * short_consistency)
    sleep_score = np.clip(0.6 * qos_weight + 0.4 * sleep_amount_score + sleep_rule_bonus, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Activity scoring
    steps_norm = (df['Daily Steps'] / 10000.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    pal_norm = (df['Physical Activity Level'] / 100.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    n = len(df)
    steps_rank = df['Daily Steps'].rank(method='average')
    pal_rank = df['Physical Activity Level'].rank(method='average')
    activity_consistency = 1.0 - (steps_rank.sub(pal_rank).abs() / n)
    activity_consistency = activity_consistency.clip(0.0, 1.0)
    activity_score = (0.6 * steps_norm + 0.2 * pal_norm + 0.2 * activity_consistency).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    # Blood pressure risk
    sys_v = df['systolic']
    dia_v = df['diastolic']
    bp_risk = np.select(
        [ (sys_v < 120) & (dia_v < 80),
          ((sys_v >= 120) & (sys_v < 130) & (dia_v < 80)),
          ((sys_v >= 130) & (sys_v < 140)) | ((dia_v >= 80) & (dia_v < 90)),
          (sys_v >= 140) | (dia_v >= 90) ],
        [0.10, 0.30, 0.60, 0.90],
        default=0.50
    )

    # BMI risk
    bmi_map = {
        'Normal': 0.10,
        'Normal Weight': 0.10,
        'Overweight': 0.40,
        'Obese': 0.80
    }
    bmi_risk = df['BMI Category'].map(bmi_map).astype(float)

    # Stress and heart-rate derived signals
    stress_norm = ((df['Stress Level'] - 3.0) / 7.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    hr_risk = ((df['Heart Rate'] - 60.0) / 40.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    # Overall risk aggregation
    overall_risk = (
        0.35 * (1.0 - sleep_score) +
        0.20 * bp_risk +
        0.15 * bmi_risk +
        0.10 * (1.0 - activity_score) +
        0.10 * stress_norm +
        0.10 * hr_risk
    ).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    # Calibrate triage thresholds using observed labeled prevalence
    positive_mask = df['Sleep Disorder'].isin(['Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea'])
    positive_rate = positive_mask.mean()
    immediate_share = float(positive_rate)
    residual = max(0.0, 1.0 - immediate_share)
    monitor_share = min(0.20, residual)
    high_quant = min(1.0, max(0.0, 1.0 - immediate_share))
    monitor_quant = min(1.0, max(0.0, 1.0 - immediate_share - monitor_share))
    high_cut = overall_risk.quantile(high_quant)
    monitor_cut = overall_risk.quantile(monitor_quant)

    triage_level = np.where(
        overall_risk >= high_cut,
        'Immediate Referral',
        np.where(overall_risk >= monitor_cut, 'Monitor and Outreach', 'Self-guided')
    )

    apnea_score = (
        df['BMI Category'].isin(['Overweight', 'Obese']).astype(int) +
        ((df['systolic'] >= 130) | (df['diastolic'] >= 85)).astype(int) +
        ((df['Sleep Duration'] >= 6.5) & (df['Quality of Sleep'] <= 7)).astype(int)
    )

    insomnia_score = (
        (df['Sleep Duration'] <= 6.0).astype(int) +
        (df['Stress Level'] >= 6).astype(int) +
        (df['Quality of Sleep'] <= 6).astype(int)
    )

    likely_condition = np.where(
        apnea_score > insomnia_score, 'Sleep Apnea',
        np.where(insomnia_score > apnea_score, 'Insomnia', 'Unknown')
    )

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'Person ID': df['Person ID'],
        'Risk Score': overall_risk.round(4),
        'Triage Level': triage_level,
        'Likely Condition': likely_condition,
        'Sleep Duration': df['Sleep Duration'],
        'Quality of Sleep': df['Quality of Sleep'],
        'Daily Steps': df['Daily Steps'],
        'Physical Activity Level': df['Physical Activity Level'],
        'BMI Category': df['BMI Category'],
        'Systolic': df['systolic'],
        'Diastolic': df['diastolic']
    })

    out = out.sort_values(['Triage Level', 'Risk Score'], ascending=[True, False])
    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'triaged_referrals.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

    # Diagnostics for observability
    metrics = {
        'spearman_steps_pal': float(df['Daily Steps'].corr(df['Physical Activity Level'], method='spearman')),
        'pearson_sleep_quality': float(df['Sleep Duration'].corr(df['Quality of Sleep'], method='pearson')),
        'label_props': {
            'null': float(df['Sleep Disorder'].isna().mean()),
            'insomnia': float((df['Sleep Disorder'] == 'Insomnia').mean()),
            'sleep_apnea': float((df['Sleep Disorder'] == 'Sleep Apnea').mean())
        },
        'thresholds': {
            'immediate_share': immediate_share,
            'monitor_share': monitor_share,
            'high_cut': float(high_cut),
            'monitor_cut': float(monitor_cut)
        }
    }
    with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'run_metrics.json'), 'w') as f:
        json.dump(metrics, f, indent=2)

import argparse
import os
import json
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Type coercions used by downstream logic
    df['Sleep Duration'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Sleep Duration'], errors='coerce')
    df['Quality of Sleep'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Quality of Sleep'], errors='coerce')
    df['Daily Steps'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Daily Steps'], errors='coerce')
    df['Physical Activity Level'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Physical Activity Level'], errors='coerce')
    df['Stress Level'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Stress Level'], errors='coerce')
    df['Heart Rate'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Heart Rate'], errors='coerce')

    # Guard checks for Sleep Duration before downstream sleep scoring
    # ASSERTION_START
sd = df['Sleep Duration']
assert sd.notna().all() and (sd >= 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Guard checks for Quality of Sleep before mapping and thresholds
    # ASSERTION_START
q = df['Quality of Sleep']
integers_ok = ((q % 1) == 0).all()
in_range_ok = q.between(1, 10).all()
non_null_ok = q.notna().all()
assert non_null_ok and in_range_ok and integers_ok
    # ASSERTION_END
    df['Quality of Sleep'] = df['Quality of Sleep'].astype(int)

    # Validate Blood Pressure string pattern before parsing
    # ASSERTION_START
    def check_bp_pattern(series):
        return series.astype(str).apply(lambda x: bool(re.match(r'^\d{2,3}/\d{2,3}$', x))).all()
    assert check_bp_pattern(df['Blood Pressure'])
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Parse Blood Pressure
    bp_parts = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True)
    df['systolic'] = bp_parts[0].astype(int)
    df['diastolic'] = bp_parts[1].astype(int)

    # Guard checks for parsed Blood Pressure before BP risk logic
    # Validate BMI Category before BMI-driven risk logic
    # ASSERTION_START
allowed_bmi = {'Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese'}
bmi_non_null = df['BMI Category'].notna().all()
bmi_allowed_ok = df['BMI Category'].isin(allowed_bmi).all()
assert bmi_non_null and bmi_allowed_ok
    # ASSERTION_END
    # Steps and Physical Activity Level relationship prior to activity scoring
    # Sleep Duration and Quality joint relationship prior to consistency scoring
    # BMI-BP coupling constraints prior to apnea inference
    # Sleep Disorder labeling prevalence used to calibrate referral rate
    # Sleep scoring
    sleep_hours = df['Sleep Duration']
    qos_map = {i: i / 10.0 for i in range(1, 11)}
    qos_weight = df['Quality of Sleep'].map(qos_map)
    sleep_amount_score = 1.0 - (np.abs(sleep_hours - 8.0) / 5.0)
    sleep_amount_score = np.clip(sleep_amount_score, 0.0, 1.0)
    long_mask = sleep_hours >= 8.0
    short_mask = sleep_hours <= 4.5
    long_consistency = np.where(long_mask, (df['Quality of Sleep'] >= 7).astype(int), 1)
    short_consistency = np.where(short_mask, (df['Quality of Sleep'] <= 6).astype(int), 1)
    sleep_rule_bonus = 0.05 * (long_consistency * short_consistency)
    sleep_score = np.clip(0.6 * qos_weight + 0.4 * sleep_amount_score + sleep_rule_bonus, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Activity scoring
    steps_norm = (df['Daily Steps'] / 10000.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    pal_norm = (df['Physical Activity Level'] / 100.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    n = len(df)
    steps_rank = df['Daily Steps'].rank(method='average')
    pal_rank = df['Physical Activity Level'].rank(method='average')
    activity_consistency = 1.0 - (steps_rank.sub(pal_rank).abs() / n)
    activity_consistency = activity_consistency.clip(0.0, 1.0)
    activity_score = (0.6 * steps_norm + 0.2 * pal_norm + 0.2 * activity_consistency).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    # Blood pressure risk
    sys_v = df['systolic']
    dia_v = df['diastolic']
    bp_risk = np.select(
        [ (sys_v < 120) & (dia_v < 80),
          ((sys_v >= 120) & (sys_v < 130) & (dia_v < 80)),
          ((sys_v >= 130) & (sys_v < 140)) | ((dia_v >= 80) & (dia_v < 90)),
          (sys_v >= 140) | (dia_v >= 90) ],
        [0.10, 0.30, 0.60, 0.90],
        default=0.50
    )

    # BMI risk
    bmi_map = {
        'Normal': 0.10,
        'Normal Weight': 0.10,
        'Overweight': 0.40,
        'Obese': 0.80
    }
    bmi_risk = df['BMI Category'].map(bmi_map).astype(float)

    # Stress and heart-rate derived signals
    stress_norm = ((df['Stress Level'] - 3.0) / 7.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    hr_risk = ((df['Heart Rate'] - 60.0) / 40.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    # Overall risk aggregation
    overall_risk = (
        0.35 * (1.0 - sleep_score) +
        0.20 * bp_risk +
        0.15 * bmi_risk +
        0.10 * (1.0 - activity_score) +
        0.10 * stress_norm +
        0.10 * hr_risk
    ).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    # Calibrate triage thresholds using observed labeled prevalence
    positive_mask = df['Sleep Disorder'].isin(['Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea'])
    positive_rate = positive_mask.mean()
    immediate_share = float(positive_rate)
    residual = max(0.0, 1.0 - immediate_share)
    monitor_share = min(0.20, residual)
    high_quant = min(1.0, max(0.0, 1.0 - immediate_share))
    monitor_quant = min(1.0, max(0.0, 1.0 - immediate_share - monitor_share))
    high_cut = overall_risk.quantile(high_quant)
    monitor_cut = overall_risk.quantile(monitor_quant)

    triage_level = np.where(
        overall_risk >= high_cut,
        'Immediate Referral',
        np.where(overall_risk >= monitor_cut, 'Monitor and Outreach', 'Self-guided')
    )

    apnea_score = (
        df['BMI Category'].isin(['Overweight', 'Obese']).astype(int) +
        ((df['systolic'] >= 130) | (df['diastolic'] >= 85)).astype(int) +
        ((df['Sleep Duration'] >= 6.5) & (df['Quality of Sleep'] <= 7)).astype(int)
    )

    insomnia_score = (
        (df['Sleep Duration'] <= 6.0).astype(int) +
        (df['Stress Level'] >= 6).astype(int) +
        (df['Quality of Sleep'] <= 6).astype(int)
    )

    likely_condition = np.where(
        apnea_score > insomnia_score, 'Sleep Apnea',
        np.where(insomnia_score > apnea_score, 'Insomnia', 'Unknown')
    )

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'Person ID': df['Person ID'],
        'Risk Score': overall_risk.round(4),
        'Triage Level': triage_level,
        'Likely Condition': likely_condition,
        'Sleep Duration': df['Sleep Duration'],
        'Quality of Sleep': df['Quality of Sleep'],
        'Daily Steps': df['Daily Steps'],
        'Physical Activity Level': df['Physical Activity Level'],
        'BMI Category': df['BMI Category'],
        'Systolic': df['systolic'],
        'Diastolic': df['diastolic']
    })

    out = out.sort_values(['Triage Level', 'Risk Score'], ascending=[True, False])
    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'triaged_referrals.csv')
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

    # Diagnostics for observability
    metrics = {
        'spearman_steps_pal': float(df['Daily Steps'].corr(df['Physical Activity Level'], method='spearman')),
        'pearson_sleep_quality': float(df['Sleep Duration'].corr(df['Quality of Sleep'], method='pearson')),
        'label_props': {

        },
        'thresholds': {
            'immediate_share': immediate_share,
            'monitor_share': monitor_share,
            'high_cut': float(high_cut),
